title: Кібератака на державні організації України з використанням шкідливих програми Cobalt Strike Beacon, GrimPlant та GraphSteel (CERT-UA#4145)

entities.name: Україна
entities.gloss: A country in Eastern Europe.

entities.gloss: Government institutions and agencies of Ukraine.

entities.name: UAC-0056
entities.gloss: A cyberespionage threat group targeting Ukrainian organizations.

entities.name: Cobalt Strike Beacon
entities.gloss: A component of the Cobalt Strike framework used as a backdoor for post-exploitation.

entities.name: GraphSteel
entities.gloss: A Go-based backdoor malware used for information stealing and command execution.

entities.name: GrimPlant
entities.gloss: A Go-based backdoor malware that executes commands received via gRPC.

entities.name: Themida
entities.gloss: A commercial software protection system used to pack and obfuscate executables.

entities.name: Discord
entities.gloss: An instant messaging and digital distribution platform.

entities.name: BitdefenderWindowsUpdatePackage.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious executable disguised as a Bitdefender update package.

entities.name: alt.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious downloader executable used to retrieve additional payloads from Discord.

entities.name: one.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious executable containing Cobalt Strike Beacon.

entities.name: dropper.exe
entities.gloss: A Go-based dropper executable used to download and execute secondary payloads.

entities.name: wisw.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious downloader executable configured to fetch payloads from Discord.

entities.name: cesdf.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious payload file hosted on Discord.

entities.name: java-sdk.exe
entities.gloss: A Go-based dropper executable establishing persistence and executing GraphSteel and GrimPlant.

entities.name: microsoft-cortana.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious executable identified as the GraphSteel backdoor.

entities.name: oracle-java.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious executable identified as the GrimPlant backdoor.
